description: Land Title Settlement Department -Kumbuka, Horana D/S Division, Kalutara District - Cad Map No. 530176
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act, No. 21 of 1998. It contains declarations of title determinations for specific land parcels, including parcel numbers, extent measurements, owner details, and encumbrances. The content is published in "PART III - LANDS" and focuses entirely on land ownership and property rights, making it a clear example of a Land Gazette (Type 4).
